simple.meaning: מַדְוֶה (madveh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “sickness.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Deuteronomy, beginning at Deuteronomy 7:15. Its contexts include Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַדְוֶה (H4064).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מַדְוֶה (madveh) / H4064 is traced through Deuteronomy 7:15, Deuteronomy 28:60 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.

timeline.evidenceText: Yahweh will take away from you all sickness; and he will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, on you, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
